notes: The thermalsensor OBJ has no "adapter" part, so only main is drawn. Descriptor colour SignalVoltage. The base manifest lists it as model_kind "flat".

appearance: A black square chip with pin dots around its edge and a cream "T" on the face.
function: A crafting chip used to build thermal and temperature probes.

appearance: A white base plate with leads and a tan/ochre ribbed cylindrical resistor body lying across it.
function: A resistor with a negative temperature coefficient (ResistorDescriptor, -0.01/K); symbol: a resistor rectangle with a diagonal hockey-stick line and "-t°" (NTC thermistor).
notes: Draws exactly the same parts as power_resistor (only the thermal coefficient differs), so the in-world model cannot tell them apart. The part name "ResistorBaseExtention" is misspelled in the OBJ. The code fetches "CapacitorCables" as the lead wires. VoltageLevelColor.Neutral, so tier none. Registered in both ElnDeviceRegistry.registerResistors and Wp9aContent with the same id 6182. Wave-1 finding: same rectangular ResistorCore as power_resistor, not ribbed.

appearance: A grey handheld meter with a yellow-green screen, a dark dial, and a yellow probe lead looping out of the top.
function: A handheld tool that shows the temperature of a block when used on it.
notes: Shares a body with multimeter/universal_meter (separate textures).

appearance: An orange, amber, glossy blob of resin.
function: A raw material collected from trees and turned into rubber.
notes: Current texture is 32px.

appearance: A small dark-wood box hung on a tree trunk, open on the front and filled with orange resin.
function: Fixed to a rubber tree log, it slowly collects tree resin (TreeResinCollectorDescriptor); not electrical, so the schematic glyph would be a pictogram rather than a circuit symbol.
notes: The model directory name is misspelled "treeresincolector". The "fill" part grows with the resin level. VoltageLevelColor.Neutral.

appearance: A short dark-grey/black bar of wire with a slightly lighter edge.
function: A raw crafting cable (GenericItemUsingDamageDescriptor) used in tungsten heating elements and lamp recipes.
notes: A raw crafting item, not a placeable cable.

appearance: A medium-grey speckled dust pile.
function: A crafting material that is smelted into a tungsten ingot.

appearance: A dark-grey ingot in the vanilla ingot shape.
function: A crafting material for tungsten heating elements, bulbs and cables.
notes: Wp12aContent adds it to the ore tag "dustLead" (likely a copy-paste bug, unrelated to icons).

appearance: A thin grey octagonal wall plate with a light disc that glows (dark blue to green, depending on the signal) and a soft halo.
function: A wall sign that shows tutorial text in the world (TutorialSignDescriptor); not a circuit device, so the schematic glyph would be an info pictogram.
notes: VoltageLevelColor.Neutral. The item is drawn with factor 1 (green glow).

appearance: A grey handheld meter with a yellow-green screen and dark dial, and red, yellow and black probe leads looping from the top.
function: A handheld tool that shows both electrical and thermal readings of a block (multimeter plus thermometer).
notes: Code TR_NAME is "AllMeter" (ElnDeviceRegistry.registerMeter subId 2); the registered display name is "Universal-Meter", item id universal_meter.

model_texture_notes: utilitypole.png
appearance: A tall, thin dark-brown wooden pole with a short crossarm at the top and a flared brown foot.
function: A grid pole that carries overhead high-voltage lines between poles (ElectricalPoleDescriptor without transformer); symbol: a line junction or pole node with an overhead line.
notes: Descriptor colour is VoltageLevelColor.Grid (not in the tier enum, no GL colour); tier HV is chosen because it uses highVoltageCableDescriptor (800V). Ghost group 3 blocks above. The descriptor name is a literal, not TR_NAME. Wave-1 finding: the plain pole has no foot (foot is drawn only with the transformer).

model_texture_notes: utilitypole.png
appearance: The brown wooden T-pole with a grey, ribbed transformer box hanging under the crossarm, cables to it, and a widened base foot.
function: A grid pole with a built-in DC-DC transformer that steps the 800V overhead line down to a local cable (ElectricalPoleDescriptor includeTransformer=true); symbol: a pole node plus a transformer (two coils).
notes: Descriptor colour Grid; tier HV (overhead line voltage). Family could also be "converter"; it is kept with utility_pole so the two read as a pair. Icon name comes from the name with "/" removed.

model_texture_notes: Rendered from the sprite sprites/cablevhv.png (CableRenderDescriptor width 3.95, height 1.95), not an OBJ.
appearance: A thick cable run along block faces, drawn from the VHV cable sprite (the thickest of the cable family).
function: Carries 3200V power (ElectricalCableDescriptor); symbol: a wire/line in the VHV colour.
notes: No OBJ model. Per the owner, cables are told apart by colour, not thickness. The current icon is a red cable segment.

appearance: A wider clear-glass case with a light frame, holding a large copper coil, a black hexagonal armature and grey contact bars.
function: A signal-controlled relay that switches a 3200V cable (ElectricalRelayDescriptor with veryHighVoltageCableDescriptor); symbol: a relay coil with a dashed link to an SPST contact, in the VHV colour.
notes: Shares the relay800 model with high_voltage_relay (both colour-coded by tier). Low/medium relays use relaybig. Wave-1 finding: the armature renders white/light grey in the front view.

appearance: A black rectangular wall box with a large white/grey knife-switch lever and contact clips on its face.
function: Manually switches a 3200V cable on or off (ElectricalSwitchDescriptor, VVU); symbol: an SPST switch in the VHV colour.
notes: Shares the highvoltageswitch model with high_voltage_switch and the shared switch texture with all switches. Per decision 3 it needs its own VHV-coloured icon.

appearance: A dark-navy square chip with white pin tabs on its sides and the text "VCA" plus a red input mark and a green output mark on its face.
function: An amplifier whose gain is set by a second signal input (AnalogChipDescriptor, 2 inputs); symbol: an amplifier triangle with a control input.
notes: The analogchips OBJ holds all chip faces; only "VCA" is drawn.

appearance: A dark-navy square chip with white pin tabs, a sawtooth-wave glyph and the text "VCO" on its face, and a red input mark.
function: Outputs a sawtooth wave whose frequency follows the input signal (AnalogChipDescriptor, 1 input); symbol: an oscillator box with a sawtooth wave.

appearance: A dark-navy square chip with white pin tabs, a sine-wave glyph and the text "VCO" on its face, and a red input mark.
function: Outputs a sine wave whose frequency follows the input signal (AnalogChipDescriptor, 1 input); symbol: an oscillator box with a sine wave (circle with ~).

model_texture_notes: battery_highvoltage uses batteryhivoltage.png.
appearance: Two tall black battery cells side by side, with a red stripe and a "100V"-style label, standing on a grey checker-plate base tray with terminal clips on top.
function: A 200V battery (BatteryDescriptor renderSpec "highvoltage", stdU x 4, MV cable); symbol: a battery cell in the MV colour.
notes: Loads batterybig.obj (type B), not the separate batterybighv.obj. The label on the texture says 100V, but the battery is 200V.

appearance: A small black box lying along the cable, with a yellow tab on one end and a green marker on its face.
function: Measures the voltage of the cable it sits on and outputs a signal (ElectricalSensorDescriptor voltageOnly); symbol: a voltmeter (V in a circle) with a signal output.
notes: The base manifest lists it as model_kind "flat".

appearance: A white square wall plate with a redstone torch (a wooden stick with a red tip) sticking straight out of it.
function: Turns an input signal into a redstone level (ElectricalRedstoneOutputDescriptor); symbol: a signal-to-redstone converter box (signal wave to redstone dust).
notes: The "led" (torch tip) glows with the output.

model_texture_notes: tex.png
appearance: A grey paddle water wheel (8 flat blades) on a light-grey support frame, with a small green generator housing on the axle.
function: Makes 50V power from flowing water (WaterTurbineDescriptor, LV cable); symbol: a generator (G in a circle) driven by a water wheel/turbine.
notes: Ghost group about 1x3x3 (the wheel spans neighbouring blocks).

appearance: A white square wall plate with four recessed square slots in a 2x2 grid (one per battery) and a status LED for each.
function: Charges portable batteries and electrical items from a 50V cable (BatteryChargerDescriptor, 200W); symbol: a charger (AC/DC box charging a battery cell).
notes: Same model and texture as 50v_battery_charger (also LV, 400W) and 200v_battery_charger (MV). "Weak" vs normal 50V cannot be shown by colour and needs another cue.

appearance: A paint roller with a dark handle and a white roller.
function: Paints cables white.
notes: One of 16 dye brushes. In 1.7.10 the white brush started empty (setLife 0). The dry overlay is now the item bar.

appearance: A tall slim white tower with a hazard-striped (yellow and black) base, a small white nacelle, and three long thin white rotor blades with a red tip light.
function: Makes 50V power from wind (WindTurbineDescriptor, LV cable); symbol: a generator (G in a circle) with a wind-turbine rotor.
notes: Ghost group spans about 4 blocks up. "halo" is the blinking red light on the nacelle.

appearance: A grey handheld meter with a yellow-green screen and dark dial, and a short antenna on top.
function: A handheld tool that shows the wireless signal channels and strengths at a spot (WirelessSignalAnalyserItemDescriptor).
notes: Code TR_NAME is "Wireless Analyser" (British spelling, Wp9cContent.registerWirelessAnalyser); the registered display name is "Wireless Analyzer". Tier signal for its colour hint only (tool, out of schematic scope).

appearance: A white square wall plate with a single grey push button, a small LED and its glow halo (the same model as the signal switch).
function: A momentary push button that broadcasts its state on a wireless channel (WirelessSignalSourceDescriptor, auto-reset); symbol: a push button with a radio-wave/antenna mark.
notes: Same ledswitch model as signal_switch, signal_switch_with_led and wireless_switch, so the icon must carry a wireless mark and a button/switch cue.

appearance: A white square wall plate with one grey antenna rod with a black tip sticking out, and a black-framed square LED window on the plate.
function: Receives a wireless signal channel and outputs it on a signal cable (WirelessSignalRxDescriptor); symbol: an antenna with an arrow into a signal output.

appearance: A white square wall plate with two parallel grey antenna rods with black tips, and a black-framed LED window.
function: Re-broadcasts wireless signals to extend their range (WirelessSignalRepeaterDescriptor); symbol: two antennas or an antenna with in and out waves.

appearance: A white square wall plate with one grey antenna rod with a black tip and a black slot mark on the plate.
function: Broadcasts the signal of its input cable on a wireless channel (WirelessSignalTxDescriptor); symbol: an antenna with outgoing radio waves.
notes: The OBJ has a "led" part, but the descriptor only fetches and draws "main".

appearance: A white square wall plate with a single grey push button, a small LED and its glow halo (the same model as the signal switch).
function: A toggle switch that broadcasts its on/off state on a wireless channel (WirelessSignalSourceDescriptor, no auto-reset); symbol: a toggle switch with a radio-wave/antenna mark.
notes: Same ledswitch model as signal_switch, signal_switch_with_led and wireless_button.

appearance: A light-grey/silver open-end spanner seen diagonally.
function: Turns small wall-mounted (six-node) blocks.

model_texture_notes: xrayscanner.png; xrayscannerscreendamage.png holds the ScreenDamage overlays (not drawn by the descriptor).
appearance: A black handheld scanner with a screen showing a grey ore picture, a small control panel with buttons and an orange LED, and a yellow-black striped grip.
function: A portable battery-powered scanner that shows ores near the player (XRayScannerDescriptor, range 7.5 blocks).
notes: Recreated for 26.x. drawItem renders the OBJ with itemDrawParent eln:item/device_obj (a held 3D model), but the item model still uses the flat icon. Text parts are drawn by state (Boot: TextInit; Run: TextRun plus one TextBat level).

appearance: A black square chip with white pin tabs on three sides and an "=1" glyph with an inversion bar on its face, with red input and green output marks.
function: A 3-input exclusive-NOR gate (LogicGateDescriptor, XNor extends Xor with inputCount 3); symbol: an XNOR gate (XOR shape with output bubble) or IEC box "=1" with an inverted output.
notes: The current flat xnorchip.png looks almost the same as xorchip.png ("=1"); the new icons must show the inversion.

appearance: A black square chip with white pin tabs on three sides and an "=1" glyph on its face, with red input and green output marks.
function: A 3-input exclusive-OR gate (LogicGateDescriptor, inputCount 3); symbol: an XOR gate (curved OR shape with an extra input arc) or IEC box "=1".

appearance: A paint roller with a dark handle and a yellow roller.
function: Paints cables yellow.
notes: One of 16 dye brushes that differ only in roller colour.

appearance: Small teal field logger on the floor with a handle, a front screen with three coloured traces, three coloured terminals on its back.
function: Logs and plots a signal value over time; schematic: oscilloscope/recorder box with a trace.
notes: 26.x (board #45); cad model.

appearance: Low grey terminal with its screen head leaning back 45 degrees; on a desk, a wall or hung from a ceiling.
function: Logs and plots a signal value over time; schematic: oscilloscope/recorder box with a trace.
notes: 26.x (board #45); cad model.
